report.checker: conformance.py reference checker, run by the operator; this service signed the operator-submitted result

VLC-L1-1.note: chain consistent AND its root and head equal the value(s) supplied independently of the log

VLC-L1-3.note: end marker is bound by the chain and names the recomputed head

VLC-L3-1b.note: declared surface accepted as stated by the producer; not recomputable from the log

VLC-L3-1d.note: exhaustiveness criterion: code audit of all appendAudit call sites at the commit named by the policy digest; bidirectional test with negative control in tests/coverage-bidirectional.test.js

VLC-L3-3.note: declared at record 0, before any event

VLC-L3-4.note: tests/coverage-bidirectional.test.js: every attached source family, exercised, writes an entry; declared-unattached reads write nothing (negative control)

VLC-L3-5.note: the adapter excludes coverage declarations from the event count

VLC-L3-6.note: surface enumerated in the log, in a well-formed declaration

VLC-L3i-1.note: adapter declares no interval attestation; L3i is not claimed by this producer

VLC-L4-1.note: every event record carries the policy digest

VLC-L4-3.note: GET /api/govern/policy: the full descriptor (per check: id, name, category, enforcement, sha256 of the check function's source); digest = sha256(JSON.stringify(descriptor)). Checks are pure functions of the input payload (see server/lib/governance.js header); re-run the pipeline on the recorded input to replay a verdict.

VLC-L5-1.note: producer declared 'self_reported': the audited process writes its own record, so the record is a claim

VLC-L5-2.note: The gateway writes and signs its own trail with its ledger key; no operator statement yet names that key (planned, L3).

VLC-L5-3.note: no reconciliation against a self-reported record declared

VLC-L5-4.note: the witnessing log itself demonstrates L4

VLC-L5-6.note: the witness states the basis on which its coverage is exhaustive (attested: the basis is relayed, not recomputed)

expected_head.source_note: head of the Ed25519-signed export marker (sealAndExportAuditChain), whose signature verifies under the ledger key named in keys/matthew-moore-operator-statement.json; see ATTESTATION.md in this capture

expected_root.source_note: genesis of the same signed marker

signature.signed: canonical JSON of .report (sorted keys, compact separators)

verify_with: tools/verify_report.py in the spec repo, against keys/vlc-report-signing.pub.json
